DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座のお申込みで、何を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your account application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座を作る時の書類を知りたいです。今は仕事を辞めて次を探しているので、勤務先の欄をどう書くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退職して求職中なので、口座申込みの書類と勤務先欄の書き方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know which documents are needed to open an account. I've left my job and am looking for another, so I'm unsure what to write in the employer field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have left work and are job hunting, and ask about account application documents and completing the employer field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の状況を正確にお伝えください。過去の勤務先と、今の状況は分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please explain your current situation accurately. We'll check your past employer separately from your situation now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の会社の書類はありますが、今も勤務している証明にはしません。次の会社もまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧勤務先の書類は現職の証明に使わず、次の仕事も未定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have documents from my previous company, but won't use them as proof I'm still employed there. My next employer hasn't been decided either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not use previous-employer documents as proof of current employment and your next job is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況で必要な書類を担当へ確認します。口座の利用目的を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask the staff which documents are needed in that situation. Please tell me what you intend to use the account for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 生活費の管理です。決まっていない給与受け取りを理由にせず、今の目的を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 口座の目的は生活費管理で、未定の給与受取を現在の目的として書かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Managing living expenses. I want to state my current purpose rather than give receipt of a salary that hasn't been arranged as the reason.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the purpose is managing living expenses and you will not list undecided salary receipt as your present purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。お住まいとご本人を確認する書類も必要になります。現在の住所が記載されたものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You'll also need documents verifying your identity and residence. Do you have something showing your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人確認の書類には今の住所があります。ほかに必要な資料があるなら一覧をもらい、足りない分を揃えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認書類には現住所があり、追加資料が必要なら一覧をもらってそろえたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My identification shows my current address. If other documents are needed, I'd like a list so I can gather anything missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your identification has your current address and you want a list of any additional documents so you can gather them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この確認票には、勤務先欄について「退職済み・次の勤務先未定」と担当へ説明し、利用目的は生活費管理として記載する相談、とまとめました。追加書類は未確定なので、前の会社の証明を現職として添えず、この確認票と現住所の本人確認書類を担当へ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: On this check sheet, I've summarized the inquiry as explaining to staff that you have left your job and your next employer is undecided, and entering management of living expenses as the purpose. Additional documents aren't confirmed yet, so don't attach your old company's certificate as current employment proof. Show staff this sheet and your identification with your current address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 退職済み、次の仕事未定、生活費管理という目的を伝えます。現住所の書類と必要な追加資料で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 退職済み、次の仕事未定、生活費管理という目的を示し、現住所と追加書類で相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain that I've left my job, the next job is undecided, and the purpose is managing living expenses. I'll consult using my current-address document and any necessary additional information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State that you left work, your next job is undecided, and the purpose is managing living expenses, and say you will consult with current-address and additional documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。現在の状況を整理していただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the staff. Thank you for organizing your current circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。価格について、何をご確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to check about the price?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: チラシで見た卵の金額と、棚の値札が違います。このチラシの価格で買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: チラシの卵と棚の価格が違うため、チラシ価格が適用されるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The egg price in the flyer differs from the shelf label. Can I buy them at this flyer price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the flyer and shelf egg prices differ and ask whether the flyer price applies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: チラシの日付と対象店舗を確認しましょう。今ご覧になっているのは今日のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the flyer's date and participating store. Is the one you're looking at for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜限定とあります。今日は別の日なので、同じ週なら使えると思っていたのが間違いでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: チラシは日曜限定で今日は別曜日なので、同じ週なら使えると思ったのは誤りだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says Sunday only. Today is another day, so I was mistaken in thinking it applied throughout the same week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the flyer is Sunday-only and today is another weekday, so thinking it applied in the same week was a mistake. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象の日と商品をご確認ください。店舗の指定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the applicable day and product. Does it specify a store too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の店舗のチラシでした。赤平のこちらの売場で、今日の同じ商品の価格を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別店舗のチラシだったので、今いる店で今日の同じ商品の価格を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was another store's flyer. I'd like to check today's price for the same product here in this Akabira section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the flyer was for another store, so you want today's price for the same product at your current store. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の表示を一緒に確認できます。数量や会員などの条件が付いていないかも見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check today's display together. Let's also see whether there are quantity or membership conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普通の価格なら二つ買わず、一つだけにします。棚のサイズもチラシと同じか、商品名と個数を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通常価格なら一つだけにし、品名とパックの個数もチラシと同じか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it's the regular price, I'll buy just one rather than two. I'd like to check the product name and number of eggs to see whether the shelf pack size matches the flyer too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take only one at regular price and want to check that the product name and number in the pack match the flyer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品名、個数、当日の条件を確認してからお選びください。会計でも金額を確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the name, number of eggs, and today's conditions before choosing. You can also verify the amount at checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 別日別店舗のチラシは使わず、今日の対象商品を見ます。必要な一つだけ選んで、レジの金額を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別日・別店舗のチラシでは判断せず、当日の対象商品を一つ選び会計額を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't rely on a flyer for another day and store; I'll look at today's applicable product. I'll choose just the one I need and check the register amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not judge from a different-date, different-store flyer, but choose one of today's applicable product and check the checkout amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示を確認してお選びいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for checking the display before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内の通路で、何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about the park paths?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨がやんだので、閉じていた道へ入ってよいですか。入口を近道で出たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨がやんだので閉鎖中の道を近道として使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The rain has stopped. Can I enter the path that was closed? I'd like a shortcut out to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use a closed path as a shortcut now that the rain has stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雨がやんだことと、通行制限が解除されたことは別です。現地の閉鎖表示は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The rain stopping and a restriction being lifted are separate things. Is the closure sign still there on site?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示は残っています。天気が回復したから安全になったと思っていました。解除が確認できるまでは入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉鎖表示は残り、晴れたから安全だと思ったが、解除を確認するまで入らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sign is still there. I thought the improved weather meant it was safe. I won't enter until I can confirm it's reopened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the closure sign remains and you thought clear weather meant safety, but will not enter until reopening is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。利用できる通路の案内を確認しましょう。今いる場所から、どこへ戻られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Let's check the information for usable paths. Where are you returning to from here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この入口です。芝生を横切れば近そうですが、足元がぬかるんでいるので、指定の通路で戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 戻りたい入口を示し、ぬかるむ芝生を横切らず指定の通路で戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This entrance. Crossing the grass looks shorter, but the ground is muddy, so I'd like to return along the designated path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the entrance you want to return to and say you want the designated path rather than cross muddy grass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口へは、案内所を背にして舗装通路を左へ進んでください。最初の分岐に「入口」の表示があります。その先も舗装通路を使い、芝生や閉鎖した道へは入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: To reach the entrance, stand with your back to the information center and go left along the paved path. The first fork has an 'Entrance' sign. Continue on the paved path beyond it, without entering the grass or closed path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が先へ行こうとしているので、閉鎖が残っていることを伝えて一緒に戻ります。地図で使える通路だけ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先へ進もうとする友人に閉鎖を知らせ、一緒に戻るため地図で使える通路だけを確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend is about to go onward, so I'll tell them the closure remains and return together. I'll check only the usable paths on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will warn your friend who is about to continue that the closure remains, and check usable paths on the map to return together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地図の左側の舗装通路が、今ご案内した入口への道です。お友達にも、雨がやんでも閉鎖表示は残っていることと、最初の分岐の「入口」表示を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The paved path on the left side of the map is the route to the entrance I just described. Please also tell your friend that the closure sign remains despite the rain stopping and about the 'Entrance' sign at the first fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 雨上がりを解除と思わず、閉鎖表示を守ります。ぬかるみを横切らず、友人と指定通路で入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 雨上がりを解除とは判断せず表示を守り、ぬかるみを横切らず友人と指定通路で戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't treat the rain ending as reopening; I'll obey the closure sign. I won't cross the mud, and will return to the entrance with my friend on the designated path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not infer reopening from the rain stopping, will obey signs, avoid crossing mud, and return on the designated path with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。足元に気をつけ、無理に近道をしないでください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Watch your footing and don't force a shortcut. Have a safe journey back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行き先のご案内で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with directions to your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約した宿へ行きたいです。この地図の経路で移動すればいいですか。今いる場所から検索したつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約した宿へ行きたいと伝え、今いる場所からのつもりで検索した経路でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to go to my booked accommodation. Should I follow this map route? I thought I'd searched from where I am now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to reach your booked accommodation and ask whether a route you thought you searched from your current location is appropriate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検索の出発地点と現在地が同じか確認しましょう。この地図はどこからの経路ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check whether the search starting point matches your current location. Where does this map's route start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宿の送迎待ち合わせ場所からでした。私はそこへまだ着いていません。まず待ち合わせ場所へ行く道が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図は送迎の待ち合わせ場所からの経路だったと説明し、まずそこまで行く道が必要だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It starts at the accommodation's shuttle meeting point. I haven't reached that yet. First, I need directions to the meeting point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the map starts at the shuttle meeting point and you first need a route to reach it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宿の案内にある待ち合わせ場所と、送迎の予約条件を確認してください。送迎は申し込まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the meeting point and shuttle booking conditions in the accommodation's instructions. Have you booked the shuttle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。地図があれば迎えが来ると思っていました。宿へ申込みと時間を聞いて、使えなければバスの経路を調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送迎は未予約で地図があれば来てもらえると思っていたと説明し、宿へ条件を聞き使えなければバスを調べると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I thought having the map meant they'd come to meet me. I'll ask the accommodation about booking and times, and if I can't use it, I'd like to look up the bus route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the shuttle is unbooked and you thought the map meant pickup was arranged, and say you will ask about conditions and look up buses if it is unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送迎が使えるかは宿へ確認しましょう。バスの場合も、現在の乗場と降車後の移動を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check shuttle availability with the accommodation. For a bus, also confirm the current boarding stop and onward journey after getting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宿から、送迎は今日は利用できないと返事が来ました。正面入口の住所も聞いたので、そこまでの現在の交通を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿から今日は送迎を使えないと返事があったと伝え、確認した正面入口の住所へ向かう交通を調べたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The accommodation replied that the shuttle isn't available today. I also asked for the front entrance address, so I'll look up current transport all the way there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the accommodation replied that no shuttle is available today, and you want to check transport to the confirmed front entrance address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地図の丸印が現在地、四角印が宿の入口ですね。丸印の右側にバスの乗場の印、四角印の手前に降車停留所の印があります。宿の送迎地点とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The circle on the map is your current location, and the square is the accommodation entrance, correct? There's a bus-stop symbol to the circle's right and an alighting-stop symbol before the square. These are separate from the accommodation's shuttle point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 丸印から右側の乗場、降車停留所から四角印の入口へ歩く区間がありますね。送迎地点を出発地にせず、この二つの徒歩区間と利用できる便を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 丸印右側の乗場までと降車停留所から四角印の宿入口までに徒歩区間があると読み返し、送迎地点を現在地にせず便も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: So there are walking sections from the circle to the stop on the right, and from the alighting stop to the square entrance. I won't use the shuttle point as my starting point; I'll check those two walking sections and available services.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that there are walking sections to the stop right of the circle and from the alighting stop to the square entrance, and say you will check services without treating the shuttle point as your location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。宿と交通事業者の最新案内を確認してお出かけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the latest accommodation and transport-operator information before setting off. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。証明書について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外の提出先へ住民票を出します。日本語の証明書と翻訳を、ここで一緒に用意してもらえるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外へ住民票を提出すると伝え、日本語の証明書と翻訳を市で一緒に用意できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm submitting a resident record overseas. I'd like to know whether you can prepare both the Japanese certificate and its translation here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need a resident record for overseas submission, and ask whether the city can prepare both the Japanese certificate and translation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住民票の申請と、翻訳や認証の条件は分けて確認しましょう。提出先の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the resident-record application separately from translation and certification requirements. Do you have the recipient's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内です。原本が必要と書いてありますが、翻訳の方法は別の欄でした。市で全部済むとは決まっていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出案内には原本と翻訳の方法が別に書かれていると示し、市で全部済むとは限らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. They say an original is needed, but the translation method is in another section. So it's not established that everything can be done at the city office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the instructions specify the original and translation method separately, and confirm the city may not handle everything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。住民票の必要な記載項目も、提出先の指定を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Please also check the recipient's required entries on the resident record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族全員か本人だけかが不明なので、提出先へ質問します。不要な個人番号を入れたものを先に取らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人分か家族全員分か不明なので提出先へ尋ね、不要な個人番号を含むものを先に取らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's unclear whether they need the whole family or just me, so I'll ask them. I'll avoid obtaining one with an unnecessary Individual Number first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the recipient whether they need you alone or the whole family, and will not first obtain a record containing an unnecessary Individual Number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定がわかってから申請できます。翻訳や認証を誰が行うかも、提出先の条件で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can apply after confirming the requirements. Also check with the recipient who must provide translation and certification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 市で出る原本を、私がコピーしたものと同じ扱いにしないで確認します。必要な原本の枚数も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 市が発行する原本と自分でコピーしたものを区別し、必要な原本枚数も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check without treating the city-issued original as equivalent to a photocopy I make myself. I'll ask how many originals are required too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish the city-issued original from your own copy and check the required number of originals too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原本の必要枚数と記載項目が確定したら、申請方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the number of originals and required entries are settled, we'll explain how to apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人か全員か、原本枚数、翻訳と認証の方法を提出先へ聞きます。指定がわかってから住民票を申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象者、原本枚数、翻訳と認証の条件を提出先へ聞き、指定が分かってから申請すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the recipient whether it's for me or everyone, the number of originals, and the translation and certification methods. I'll apply for the resident record after confirming the requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the recipient about people covered, original count, and translation and certification conditions, then apply once requirements are known. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。提出先の指定を持ってお越しください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please visit with the recipient's requirements. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診のご相談で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your medical consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜に咳が続きます。家族も咳をしていますが、今日は私の受診で来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜に咳が続くと伝え、家族にも症状があるが今日は自分の受診だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My cough continues at night. My family is coughing too, but today I've come for my own visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your nighttime cough continues and family members also have symptoms, but today you are seeking care for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の症状として伺います。いつからで、日中も同じように咳が出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask about your own symptoms. When did they start, and do you cough similarly during the day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は四日前からで、昼は少なく夜に多いです。家族は先週からですが、それを私の開始日にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は四日前からで昼は少なく夜に多いと答え、家族の開始日とは区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine started four days ago, with little coughing in the daytime and more at night. My family's started last week, but I won't use that as my start date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say yours began four days ago, is less frequent by day and more at night, and distinguish your onset from your family's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 症状の時間帯を担当へ伝えます。ほかに今つらいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the staff the times of your symptoms. Is anything else troubling you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 寝つきにくいです。前に聞かれた「続いていますか」が、一日中なのか何日もなのかわからなかったので、聞き返したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 咳で寝つきにくいと伝え、続くという質問が日数か一日の時間帯か分からない場合は聞き返したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I struggle to fall asleep. When I was previously asked 'Has it been continuing?', I didn't know whether that meant all day or for several days, so I'd like to ask for clarification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the cough makes falling asleep difficult and you want to ask again when unsure whether 'continuing' concerns the number of days or times within a day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 質問の意味が不明なら、その場で確認してください。医療者へ症状の説明と聞き返しの希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If a question's meaning is unclear, check it there and then. I'll tell medical staff about your symptoms and wish to ask for clarification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「何日間という意味ですか、それとも一日中ですか」と確認します。家族の情報が必要なら、自分のものと分けて答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問が何日間か一日中かを確認すると伝え、家族の情報が必要なら自分の症状と分けて答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask, 'Do you mean how many days, or all day long?' If family information is needed, I'll answer separately from my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check whether the question means several days or all day, and provide any needed family information separately from your own symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。使っている薬や受診の記録があれば、ご本人のものをご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you have medication information or visit records, please prepare your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の四日間と夜の咳、睡眠の困りごとを伝えます。質問の時間の意味を確かめ、家族の症状とは分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四日間の夜の咳と睡眠の困りごとを伝え、質問の時間の意味を確認して家族の症状とは分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll describe my four days of nighttime coughing and sleep difficulty. I'll clarify the time meaning in questions and explain separately from my family's symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will describe four days of nighttime cough and sleep trouble, clarify questions' time meaning, and distinguish family symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。医療スタッフへご案内します。待つ間に症状が変わればお知らせください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to medical staff. Let us know if symptoms change while waiting. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。不安な連絡について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about a worrying message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人らしいアカウントから、お金を急いで送ってほしいと来ました。いつもの写真ですが、本人か不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人に見えるアカウントから急な送金依頼が来たと伝え、同じ写真でも本人か不安だと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An account that looks like my friend's asked me to send money urgently. It has the usual photo, but I'm unsure it's really them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say an account resembling your friend's urgently requested money, and you are unsure of identity despite the matching photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送金はしましたか。いつもの連絡先とは違うアカウントでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you sent any money? Is it a different account from the usual contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送っていません。新しいアカウントで、友人の写真だけ同じです。口座の番号が送られてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送金で相手は新しいアカウントだと説明し、口座情報を受信しただけだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't sent anything. It's a new account with only the same photo as my friend. They sent me an account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you have not sent money, the sender is a new account, and you have only received bank-account information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真だけで本人とは判断しないでください。もともと使っていた連絡先で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't judge identity from a photo alone. Can you check through the contact you originally used?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の番号へ電話したら、友人は頼んでいないと言いました。受信した口座情報と会話を消さずに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の電話番号で友人に確認したら依頼していないと言われたと伝え、受信記録を消さず残すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I called the original number, and my friend said they hadn't asked for money. I'll keep the received account details and conversation without deleting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your friend denied the request when contacted at the original number, and you will keep received records without deleting them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した結果も記録しましょう。相手に身分証や認証番号などを送ったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's record the verification result too. Have you sent the account any identification, verification codes, or similar information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 送っていません。こちらの住所も伝えていません。相手の口座を受け取っただけで、入力や送金はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 身分証、認証番号、住所は送っておらず、口座情報を受け取っただけで入力も送金もしていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I haven't given my address either. I've only received their account details and haven't entered anything or sent money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not sent identification, verification codes, or your address, and only received account details without entering anything or transferring money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受信した情報と、送った情報を分けて担当へ伝えてください。保存とサービス側の相談方法もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the staff separately what you received and what you sent. We'll also explain how to preserve records and seek help from the service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に元の番号で確認した結果と、未送金、情報未送信を伝えます。相手へ返信せず、保存した記録で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既知の番号で確認した結果と未送金・情報未送信を伝え、相手には返信せず記録で相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report the result of checking with my friend at the original number, no transfer, and no information sent. I won't reply to the account; I'll consult using the saved records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give the known-number verification result, no transfer, and no information sent, and seek advice with records without replying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。確認してからご相談いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the staff. Thank you for checking and then seeking advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。荷物の発送で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with sending your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手作りのお菓子を家族へ送りたいです。冷やして保存するものなので、普通の箱で送れるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵保存する手作り菓子を家族に送りたいと伝え、普通の箱で送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send homemade sweets to my family. They need refrigerated storage, so I'd like to ask whether I can send them in a normal box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send homemade sweets requiring refrigeration to family, and ask whether a normal box is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保存条件と送る場所を確認しましょう。作った食品の取扱いは、輸送方法に合うか確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the storage conditions and destination. Homemade food needs checking to see whether it is compatible with the transport method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛先はこちらです。冷蔵で保存しています。外が寒ければ普通の配送でも冷えたままだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先と冷蔵保存の必要を伝え、外が寒ければ輸送中も冷えると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the destination. I'm storing them refrigerated. I thought if it was cold outside, normal shipping would keep them cold too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the destination and refrigeration requirement, and explain you thought cold outside weather would keep them cold during transport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外の気温だけで、輸送中の温度を判断できません。利用できる取扱いを担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The outside temperature alone can't establish the transport temperature. Let's check available handling with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 作った日と材料をメモしました。ただ、いつまで安全に食べられるかを窓口で保証してもらうつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作った日と材料を控えたと伝え、食べられる安全な期限を窓口に保証してもらうつもりはないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've noted the preparation date and ingredients. But I'm not intending to ask the counter to guarantee how long they'll be safe to eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you noted the preparation date and ingredients and do not intend to ask the counter to guarantee a safe eating deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食品の安全な期限をこちらで決めることはできません。発送の条件と梱包について確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't decide a safe food-use deadline here. We'll check the shipping conditions and packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取扱いが条件に合わなければ、今日は送らず別の贈り物にします。冷蔵対応という言葉だけで、全部の条件を満たすと思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取扱いが保存条件に合わなければ今日は送らず別の贈り物にすると伝え、冷蔵対応の一言で判断しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the available handling doesn't meet the conditions, I won't send them today and will choose a different gift. I'll be careful not to think the words 'refrigerated service' alone mean every condition is met.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say if handling does not meet the storage conditions you will not send today and will choose another gift, without deciding from 'refrigerated service' alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。対象となる荷物の条件と利用できる方法を確認してから選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let's check the parcel eligibility conditions and available methods before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 気温ではなく保存条件で相談し、内容と作った日を伝えます。条件が合う発送方法が確認できた場合だけ送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 気温ではなく保存条件で相談し、材料と作った日を伝えて条件に合う方法が確認できた場合だけ送ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll consult based on storage conditions rather than air temperature and give the contents and preparation date. I'll send only if a shipping method meeting the conditions is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss storage conditions rather than weather, give ingredients and preparation date, and send only when a suitable method is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が取扱いを確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Staff will check the handling. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。振り込みについて、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about transfers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃と更新の費用を同じ会社へ払います。合計を一度に振り込めばよいか、書類を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃と更新費を同じ会社へ払うと説明し、合算して一度の振込にしてよいか書類で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm paying rent and a renewal fee to the same company. I'd like to check the documents to see whether I can combine the total in one transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are paying rent and renewal fees to one company and want to check whether a combined single transfer is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの請求の振込先と、指定された記入事項を見ましょう。同じ口座ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at each bill's account and required entries. Are they the same account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口座は同じですが、更新分には番号を付けるよう書かれています。まとめると何の支払いかわからなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口座は同じだが更新分には番号指定があると示し、合算すると支払目的を区別できないのではと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The account is the same, but the renewal payment says to add a number. If I combine them, it seems they may not know what each payment is for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the same account but a specified number for renewal, and ask whether combining would prevent distinguishing payment purposes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取側の識別条件は管理会社へ確認してください。銀行で、まとめて受理されるとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the recipient's identification requirements with the management company. The bank can't determine that a combined payment will be accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社に聞いたら、二回に分けて番号を指定してほしいとのことでした。振込名義の欄に入れる順番も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社から二件に分けて番号を付けるよう案内されたと伝え、振込名義に入れる順番も確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked the company, and they said to make two separate payments with the specified numbers. I'd also like to check the order of entries in the transfer-name field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the company instructed two separate numbered payments, and you want to check the order of entries in the transfer name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理会社の指定をもとに入力してください。二件それぞれの金額と、手数料がかかるかも確定前に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter them according to the management company's instructions. Let's check each amount and whether fees apply before confirming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀行の自分用メモだけに番号を書いて、相手へ伝わったと思わないようにします。相手に表示される欄を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分用のメモに書くだけでは相手に伝わらないと確認し、受取側へ表示される欄を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll be careful not to write the number only in my private bank memo and assume the recipient gets it. I'll check the field shown to the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that a private memo alone does not communicate with the recipient, and say you want to check the field displayed to them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。相手への表示と、ご自身の記録を区別してください。迷った場合は、確定前にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Distinguish the recipient's display from your own records. Ask before confirming if you're unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家賃と更新を指定どおり二件に分け、相手に見える番号と名義を確認します。各金額、手数料、控えも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定通り二件に分け、相手へ表示される番号と名義、各金額、手数料、控えを確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll split rent and renewal into two as instructed and check the number and name visible to the recipient. I'll also check each amount, fee, and receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will make two transfers as specified and check the recipient-visible numbers and names, individual amounts, fees, and receipts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認画面を一件ずつ照らし合わせてください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Compare each confirmation screen separately. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お会計で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help at checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この電子マネーは残りが少ないです。足りない分を現金で払えるか、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電子マネー残高が少ないと伝え、不足分を現金で払えるか操作前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My e-money balance is low. I'd like to check first whether I can pay the shortfall in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your e-money balance is low and ask before operating whether the shortfall can be paid in cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 併用できるかは決済の種類で確認します。お使いのものと、残高の表示を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether methods can be combined depends on the payment type. Could you show me which one you use and its balance display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この種類で、残高はこちらです。併用できると決めて読み取りを始める前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 決済の種類と残高を示し、併用できると決めて読み取りを始める前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this type, and here's the balance. I'd like to ask before starting to scan on the assumption that combining payments is allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the payment type and balance, and say you want confirmation before scanning rather than assuming payment methods can be combined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取扱いを確認します。併用できない場合は、ほかに支払う方法がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the policy. If combining isn't possible, do you have another way to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全額を払える現金があります。使えないなら無理にチャージせず、現金にします。袋は持参したので不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全額払える現金があると答え、併用できなければチャージせず現金にし持参バッグを使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have enough cash for the full amount. If it isn't possible, I won't force a top-up; I'll pay cash. I brought my bag, so don't need one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have enough cash for everything, will use cash without topping up if combining is unavailable, and use your own bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認しました。端末では、その電子マネーと現金は併用できません。全額を現金でお支払いになれます。袋は不要として、商品だけの合計をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked. This terminal can't combine that e-money with cash. You can pay the full amount in cash. With no bag needed, I'll give the total for the products alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、全額を現金で払います。電子マネーのカードは読み取り機にかざさず、合計を見てから現金を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電子マネーと現金を併用できないと確認できたので、カードをかざさず全額現金で払い、合計を見てから現金を出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll pay everything in cash. I won't tap the e-money card on the reader; I'll look at the total before handing over cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say combining e-money and cash has been confirmed unavailable, so you will not tap the card and will pay all in cash after checking the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、案内した操作に従ってください。支払う方法を決めてから会計を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please follow the instructions provided. Let's decide the payment method before proceeding at checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 併用の可否を確かめ、できなければ全額現金で払います。袋は買わず、持参バッグに入れます。
